parameters.query:
WITH input_data AS (
    SELECT $1::JSONB AS data
),

upsert_client AS (
    INSERT INTO clients (
        client_code,
        name,
        company_name,
        email,
        website,
        status
    )
    SELECT
        data->>'client_code',
        data->>'client_name',
        data->>'company_name',
        data->>'client_email',
        NULLIF(data->>'website', ''),
        'active'
    FROM input_data

    ON CONFLICT (client_code)
    DO UPDATE SET
        name = EXCLUDED.name,
        company_name = EXCLUDED.company_name,
        email = EXCLUDED.email,
        website = EXCLUDED.website,
        status = 'active'

    RETURNING
        id,
        client_code,
        name,
        company_name,
        email,
        website
),

save_campaign AS (
    INSERT INTO campaigns (
        campaign_code,
        client_id,
        source_submission_id,
        product_service,
        target_audience,
        offer,
        objective,
        brand_tone,
        status,
        brief
    )
    SELECT
        input_data.data->>'campaign_code',
        upsert_client.id,

        'FORM-' || encode(
            digest(
                input_data.data->>'idempotency_material',
                'sha256'
            ),
            'hex'
        ),

        input_data.data->>'product_service',
        input_data.data->>'target_audience',
        input_data.data->>'offer',
        input_data.data->>'campaign_objective',
        input_data.data->>'brand_tone',
        'brief_received',
        input_data.data->'brief'

    FROM input_data
    CROSS JOIN upsert_client

    ON CONFLICT (source_submission_id)
    DO UPDATE SET
        updated_at = NOW()

    RETURNING
        id,
        campaign_code,
        client_id,
        source_submission_id,
        status,
        created_at,
        updated_at
),

write_log AS (
    INSERT INTO automation_logs (
        workflow_name,
        campaign_id,
        level,
        event_type,
        message,
        details
    )
    SELECT
        '02 - AdFlow Client Intake',
        save_campaign.id,
        'info',
        'campaign_intake_saved',
        'Client and campaign brief saved successfully.',
        jsonb_build_object(
            'campaign_code',
            save_campaign.campaign_code,
            'client_code',
            upsert_client.client_code,
            'company_name',
            upsert_client.company_name
        )
    FROM save_campaign
    CROSS JOIN upsert_client

    RETURNING id
)

SELECT
    save_campaign.id AS campaign_id,
    save_campaign.campaign_code,
    save_campaign.source_submission_id,
    save_campaign.status,
    save_campaign.created_at,
    save_campaign.updated_at,

    upsert_client.id AS client_id,
    upsert_client.client_code,
    upsert_client.name AS client_name,
    upsert_client.company_name,
    upsert_client.email AS client_email,
    upsert_client.website

FROM save_campaign
JOIN upsert_client
    ON upsert_client.id = save_campaign.client_id;
